'''[[Sharad Hett]]'s cruiser''' was the small spaceship in which Hett fled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. He crashed it in the deserts of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SW11">[[Star Wars (1998) 11|''Star Wars'' (1998) 11]]</ref>
